projection.purpose: Persist state through a host-owned storage port.

contract.input: Versioned session bytes, content identity and integrity metadata.
contract.authority: The core serializes meaning; the storage adapter owns files or browser storage.
contract.step: Validate format, content identity and invariants before replacing a session.
contract.commit: Use atomic host storage and keep the previous valid save on failure.
contract.reject: Migrate explicitly or refuse unknown versions.

test.given: A save belongs to another content revision.
test.then: Load refuses visibly; the active session is unchanged.
